description: Find every legislator representing a geographic coordinate — both tiers. Pass latitude and longitude to get the state senators and representatives for that location (and potentially governor/executive officials), plus the coordinate's two US Senators and its US Representative. jurisdiction.classification separates the tiers: "state" is a state legislature, "country" is the US Congress. current_role.org_classification does not — it is "upper"/"lower" for a US Senator exactly as for a state senator. Useful for constituent-to-representative matching, address-based policy research, and electoral boundary analysis. This server does not geocode addresses — the caller must provide decimal-degree coordinates. Use include=offices to get contact information alongside the legislator list.

include.description: Related data to inline. "offices" includes phone, fax, and address. "links" includes website and social links. "other_names" includes alternate/former names, "other_identifiers" cross-system IDs, and "sources" the provenance URLs behind the record.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (e.g., 47.6062 for Seattle, WA).

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (e.g., -122.3321 for Seattle, WA).

name: openstates_get_legislators_by_location

count.description: Number of legislators returned for this coordinate.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_coordinate`: Latitude or longitude is outside valid range. `upstream_timeout`: Open States did not answer within the per-request timeout. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

federalCount.description: Results serving the US Congress (jurisdiction.classification = "country") — the coordinate's two US Senators and its US Representative.

division_id.description: OCD division the district maps to (e.g., "ocd-division/country:us/state:wa/sldu:37"). Null when undistricted, absent when upstream omits it.

email.description: Email address. Empty string when not available.

family_name.description: Family (last) name. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

given_name.description: Given (first) name. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

image.description: Official headshot URL. Absent when no photo is published.

classification.description: Government level this legislator serves: "state" for a state legislature, "country" for the US Congress. The field that separates the two tiers in this result set.

links.description: Website and social links when include=links is requested.

note.description: Link description. Empty string when Open States recorded no description — common on person links.

offices.description: Contact offices when include=offices is requested.

openstates_url.description: Open States profile URL. Empty string when Open States recorded none.

other_identifiers.description: Cross-system identifiers when include=other_identifiers is requested.

other_names.description: Alternate/former names when include=other_names is requested.

note.description: Note describing the alternate name. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

party.description: Primary party label. Empty string when unknown.

sources.description: Provenance sources when include=sources is requested.

note.description: Source note. Empty string when Open States recorded no note.

notice.description: Present when no legislators were found — explains why (e.g., location outside US boundaries or unsupported territory).

title: Get Legislators by Location
